Technology stocks were firming in pre-market trading Wednesday morning.
Among technology stocks likely to move on news:
(+) Ultralife ( ULBI ) jumped almost 13% higher in Tuesday's late session after the communications equipment company said it received a $10.9 million contract to supply Thales Defense & Security with vehicle amplifier-adaptors and mounted power amplifiers for use in the US Army's network modernization efforts. Shipments are expected to begin before the end of the year and continue throughout 2019.
In other sector news:
(+) Intelsat SA ( I ) advanced during extended Tuesday trading, rising just under 1%, after the satellite communication company said its Intelsat Jackson Holdings unit priced a $700 million private placement of 8.500% senior notes due 2024 at 100.75% of par plus accrued interest since Sept. 19. The wholly owned subsidiary expects to use net proceeds to redeem all of the remaining 7.50% senior notes due 2021 that were not redeemed using the proceeds of the parent company's private placement of 8.500% senior notes due 2024 on Sept. 19.
(=) Novanta ( NOVT ) was flat early Wednesday after the photonics and precision motion components company said it has acquired the final 24% of Laser Quantum it didn't already own for $45.7 million in cash and restricted stock. Laser Quantum produces solid state continuous-wave and femtosecond lasers for the medical market and Novanta said it expects the acquistion will increase its adjusted per-share earnings after closing. It will fund the deal using $30.7 million in available cash and borrowings from its credit facility in addition to issuing $15 million of restricted stock.
